Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

casimir 0.0.2

  • Island X retuned: moderate fishing pressure (q = 0.004, Dentex catchability by tactic x 0.3), so stocks decline without collapsing. Boats join and leave over the whole period (island_x(entry, exit)), and trips grow with the fleet, so an old frame survey goes out of date.
  • Effort (landings, i.e. trips) estimated alongside catch: effort_by(), plot_effort_series(), cas_effort_truth().
  • Spin the whole programme over the years: spin_series(), summary_spins(), plot_spin_series() (band or paired bars), and spins_long(), all estimates with the truth as one long table.
  • App: new step 6 Series (catch and effort over the survey years, route and frame), Spin x1000 > Over the years, long-table download (csv or rds) in Cash out, fleet sliders on the Island tab, the top pills as Build / new island and Roll / redraw buttons, Build from any empty tab.
  • Requires cpueTargeting 0.4.2 (entry_years, exit_years).

casimir 0.0.1

  • First prototype: Island X on the landing-site layer of cpueTargeting (landing-sites branch), frame survey, stratified multi-stage design, field forms A-C with planted artefacts, four-step raising with variance and the CPUE x effort route, replicates, and a Shiny app in the FLOSS layout.
